title: Certificate: code/rank.py
spec: project_spec.md §5 filters, sort key, status derivation
signature: choose(candidates, profile, request, capacity) -> tuple[Candidate | None, AffordabilityStatus]
guarantees: Filter 1: method in payment_methods_user_will_consider; wait requires full_payment accepted; not_recommended always eligible.
Filter 2: installments require number_of_payments*payment_frequency_days/30 <= max_installment_months; None => rejected.
Status: full_payment day 0 with no changes => affordable_now; installments/partial/any-with-changes => affordable_with_plan; wait => affordable_later.
Deterministic: sort_key is a total order (option_id or '' as final tie-break).
